title: Linear model and gradient descent
hints: Compute the residual r = X @ w - y first; both the loss and the gradient come from it.
Check shapes: X.T is (D, N) and r is (N,), so X.T @ r is (D,), the shape of w. Do not forget the 2/N factor.
grad = (2.0 / N) * X.T @ r, and the step is w - lr * grad (against the gradient).

wrong.sum_not_mean.py: gradient is not divided by N (fails the finite-difference check)
wrong.missing_transpose.py: uses X instead of X.T in the gradient (shape error)
